name: Orbs of Power
description: No armour, no lasers, no wings: just blobs. Slimy green orbs square off against slimy purple ones across a muddy patch of dirt. Pawns are squishy little drops, the rook a big fat glob, the knight an oval wobbler, the bishop a long drip. The king wears a golden crown, the queen an even taller one. Everything oozes around its friends and smacks into its enemies.
